## Producing pm

### Project planning

- **Lead:** [`agency:project-management-studio-producer`](../toolkit/cards/production/producing-pm/agency--project-management-studio-producer.md) — The 3RDWRONG tool for {job.replace("-"," ")} — lead.
- **Specialist:** [`agency:project-manager-senior`](../toolkit/cards/production/producing-pm/agency--project-manager-senior.md) — The 3RDWRONG tool for {job.replace("-"," ")} — specialist when Use when the approved work needs this capability: Converts specs to tasks and remembers previous projects.
  Trigger: Use when the approved work needs this capability: Converts specs to tasks and remembers previous projects. Focused on realistic scope, no background processes, exact spec requirements
- **Specialist:** [`figma:generate-project-plan`](../toolkit/cards/production/producing-pm/figma--generate-project-plan.md) — The 3RDWRONG tool for {job.replace("-"," ")} — specialist when Use when the approved work needs this capability: Generate a FigJam project plan board from a PRD plus codebase context.
  Trigger: Use when the approved work needs this capability: Generate a FigJam project plan board from a PRD plus codebase context. Interactive flow: research → propose sections → per-section deep research → per-section content + block-shape proposal → create FigJam → skeleton → fill → diagrams → wrap. Each content block (section, nested section, intro callout, table, multi-column text, sticky column, diagram section, metadata strip) has its own subskill reference file. Use when the user asks for 'project plan in FigJam', 'interactive project plan', '/generate-project-plan', or provides a PRD and wants per-section confirmation on content + rendering
- **Specialist:** [`skill:feature-prioritization`](../toolkit/cards/production/producing-pm/skill--feature-prioritization.md) — The 3RDWRONG tool for {job.replace("-"," ")} — specialist when When choosing between scoped studio initiatives or client backlog items.
  Trigger: When choosing between scoped studio initiatives or client backlog items.
